title: Roundtables: Inside the Quest for Cognitive Immortality
author: MIT Technology Review
text:
Available only for MIT Technology Review subscribers.
Listen to the session or watch below In an effort to reach an elusive continuity of the self, some far-thinking technologists are working on ways to keep your brain going—even beyond death. Science editor Mary Beth Griggs and senior editor for biomedicine Antonio Regalado explore possible paths to keep your mind going, including gradual brain replacement and uploading our memories to the cloud. Speakers: Antonio Regalado, Senior Editor, Biomedicine, and Mary Beth Griggs, Science Editor

Recorded on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 Related Stories: Six wild ideas for perpetuating your mind Inside the stealthy startup that pitched brainless human clones Technology that lets us “speak” to our dead relatives has arrived.
